name: TimeScrubber
intent: A minimal, precise intraday timeline with bar / line / dots tracks, a playhead, and an optional two-handle range.
when: A surface reads a window of time rather than a single moment

commonMistakes.mistake: Re-picking which range handle to move on every pointer-move
commonMistakes.fix: Choose the handle on pointer-down and hold it for the gesture, clamping each end against its partner
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Hand the drag over mid-gesture when one end passes the other

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @core/core-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.
